transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you please tell me what brings you in to see me today?

I'm here because I've been experiencing really extreme mood swings for the past nine to ten months. I keep alternating between periods of feeling incredibly high and energetic, and times when I feel deeply depressed and empty.
During these episodes of extreme mood swings, have you ever experienced any break from reality, such as hearing voices or seeing things that aren't there?
No, I've never experienced anything like that. I don't hear voices or see things that aren't actually there.
Can you describe the duration and frequency of your high and energetic periods, and have you noticed any impairment in your social or occupational functioning during those times?

Those high and energetic periods have been going on for about nine months now. As for how it affects my work or social life during those times, I'm not entirely sure, but I just feel like I'm constantly on the go.
Did you ever require hospitalization or have any severe episodes where you lost control or had significant problems with daily life during those high and energetic periods?
No, I've never been hospitalized during those high-energy times. I don't recall ever completely losing control or having a major crisis of that scale, even though I definitely had a ton of energy.

During those high and energetic periods, did you experience any significant distress or impairment in social or occupational functioning, or were you able to function relatively normally, perhaps even feeling more productive?

I didn't feel distressed at all; I actually felt incredibly productive and had overflowing energy. I would start multiple projects at once and do far more work than usual during those times. I even stayed up for several nights in a row to keep working and felt completely fine.
Did any of those high-energy periods last for at least a week, or were they typically shorter, lasting only a few days?
Oh, they lasted much longer than just a week or a few days. That high-energy state has actually been ongoing continuously for about nine months now.

Within those nine months of high-energy state, were there any distinct periods that lasted at least 7 consecutive days where you felt abnormally high or irritable, or did the entire 9 months feel like one continuous episode?
Honestly, I'm not quite sure if there were distinct weeks like that. It's really hard to remember because that whole nine-month period just felt like one big blur.

Do you think you could have had a period of at least 7 consecutive days where you felt abnormally high or irritable, even if the whole 9 months felt like a blur, or was the high-energy state more consistent and less episodic?

Yes, I definitely experienced those feelings of being abnormally high, irritable, and full of energy for periods much longer than seven days. In fact, it wasn't just short, isolated spikes; those feelings were highly consistent and lasted throughout almost that entire nine-month period.

Did you have any periods of at least 4 consecutive days where you felt abnormally high or irritable, and if so, did those periods cause significant distress or impairment in social or occupational functioning, or were they more of a subtle, yet noticeable, change in your mood and energy?

Yes, I definitely had periods of feeling abnormally high, euphoric, and highly irritable that lasted much longer than four days. I didn't feel any distress during those times, but it was a very obvious and extreme shift in my mood and energy rather than a subtle change.

Can you think of any specific instance or period during those high-energy times when your abnormal mood or increased energy caused you or others significant problems, or led to hospitalized, or resulted in relationships being damaged, even if you didn't feel distressed yourself?

I'm really not sure and don't recall any specific instances like that. I don't remember my high-energy periods causing severe consequences like hospitalization or major damage to my relationships. It was more about me just feeling extremely active and busy.
